item.title: Burning of Kingston returns in October with full slate of reenactments and other events
item.description: KINGSTON, N.Y. — The Burning of Kingston will return on Oct. 15-18 with a weekend full of events and reenactments as the U.S. commemorates the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence on July 4, 1776, the city announced on Wednesday.
